definitions.definition: Misspelling of don't.
Obsolete spelling of don't.

parsedExamples.example: dont tread on me

examples: dont tread on me

definitions.definition: to come
a (piece of) work, a deed
of/from whom/which, whose; whereof

parsedExamples.example: Vous rappelez-vous ce dont je vous ai parlé ?
parsedExamples.translation: Do you remember that of which we spoke?

parsedExamples.example: Il n’est rien dont je sois encore certain.
parsedExamples.translation: There is nothing of which I am still certain.

parsedExamples.example: Quel est le pays dont provient cette marchandise suspecte ?
parsedExamples.translation: What is the country from which the suspicious merchandise comes?

parsedExamples.example: J’ai décidé d’abandonner l’affaire dont je vous ai entretenu il y a quelques jours.
parsedExamples.translation: I decided to abandon the matter of which we have been speaking for a few days.

parsedExamples.example: La maladie dont il est mort porte un nom imprononçable.
parsedExamples.translation: The disease of which he died has an unpronounceable name.

parsedExamples.example: Les pays dont nous n’avons point de connaissance sont les destinations privilégiées des grands aventuriers.
parsedExamples.translation: The countries of which we have little knowledge are the privileged destinations of great adventurers.

parsedExamples.example: Ces étoiles — dont le nom m’échappe — sont les plus brillantes de la voûte céleste.
parsedExamples.translation: These stars, whose names escape me, are the brightest in the skies.

parsedExamples.example: Le Québec est une province du Canada dont les frontières correspondent au territoire de la nation québécoise.
parsedExamples.translation: Quebec is a province of Canada whose borders correspond to the Quebecois nation.

definitions.definition: by which

parsedExamples.translation: The blow by which he was struck.

definitions.definition: Denotes a part of a set, may be translated as "including" or such as in some situations.

parsedExamples.example: Il a eu dix enfants, dont neuf filles.
parsedExamples.translation: He had ten children, nine of them girls.

examples: Il a eu dix enfants, dont neuf filles.
